correctness.rationale: PASS: Classified every proper induced subposet of an even crown (N>=4) by the multiset of selected cyclic path runs: isolated vertices type s, nontrivial even runs type e_l with trivial automorphism, odd runs with one of two endpoint parities and reversal symmetry 2. Isomorphisms between two identical multisets have multiplicity product c_t! h_t^{c_t}. Marking one selected run, choosing starting parity and dividing by r gives P_N(X)=N/2 sum_r (1/r)[z^N]tr(T^r); the coefficient A_N(c) is the number of labeled source subsets, so the squared A times automorphism factor gives the full rank polynomial. The full and empty source are separated correctly. Directly enumerated strict-comparability-preserving partial bijections for N=4 and N=6 independently, obtaining [1,16,24,16,4] and [1,36,198,204,90,36,6], agreeing with the formula and code. The two-missing-vertex classification supplies rank N-2=N^2(3N-8)/4 for N>=6; the factorial lower bound (N/2)! and upper 4^N 2^(N/2)(N/2)! imply both NlogN limits. Finite checks do not prove the infinite coefficient formula or limits.

value.rationale: PASS: The graded size of the actual inverse monoid is a natural exact invariant complementary to its published generator rank. Counts every embedded partial isomorphism by domain size for every even N, identifies sharp defect-two coefficients and a quantified rarity of extendible partial maps. These are not unmotivated slices or routine exercises once the parity-sensitive cyclic path classification is accounted for.

limitations: Only even N>=4 crowns; actual partial bijections are order-preserving and -reflecting, not arbitrary injections.
The transfer formula is a finite coefficient algorithm, not a simple single-variable rational generating function; no sharp multiplicative total asymptotic.
